root_cause: The datepicker does not hide on blur when the entered date is outside the allowed range because there is no blur event listener to close the calendar; the existing hide logic is tied to validation or explicit hide calls that are not triggered on Tab away.
repair_strategy: Add a blur event listener to the input field in non-inline mode that calls datepicker.hide(), ensuring the calendar closes when the user tabs away regardless of date validity.

edits.after:
const listeners = [
        [inputField, 'keydown', onKeydown.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'focus', onFocus.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'mousedown', onMousedown.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'click', onClickInput.bind(null, this)],
        [inputField, 'paste', onPaste.bind(null, this)],
        [document, 'mousedown', onMousedownDocument],
        [document, 'touchstart', onMousedownDocument],
        [window, 'resize', picker.place.bind(picker)],
        [inputField, 'blur', this.hide.bind(this)]
      ];

expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can reliably close the datepicker by tabbing out of the field, preventing unexpected focus trapping and satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: The datepicker will hide on blur even if the user intends to correct an invalid date; however the requirement specifies that Tab away should close the calendar regardless of validity.
Inline pickers are unaffected because the listener is added only in the non‑inline branch.
If other code depends on the blur event to keep the picker open for custom validation, that behavior will change; but the datepicker's own validation already runs on input change.
verification_requirements: After typing a valid or invalid date and pressing Tab, the datepicker element must not be visible.
Clicking outside the picker should still hide it.
Inline pickers must remain visible when their host element receives blur.
Selecting a date via the mouse grid should still update the field and hide the picker if configured.
The blur listener should not cause duplicate hide calls or errors.
